Answer focus: Design a Real-Time Ads Click-Through Rate (CTR) and Conversion Rate (CVR) Prediction System (Meta / Google Ads):.

A complete answer must start with measurable quality, latency, throughput, cost, privacy, and freshness targets. Then trace data from collection through training, offline evaluation, serving, monitoring, feedback, and rollback. Quantify the main bottleneck and explain the tradeoff behind each component instead of listing technologies.

Read “DLRM: An advanced, open source deep learning recommendation model” first for the intuition. Then use “Patterns for Personalization in Recommendations and Search” to check implementation details, tradeoffs, or failure modes.
